title: Sharp ratios for low-index Neumann eigenvalues on convex domains
summary: Let $Ω\subset\mathbb{R}^N$ be a bounded open convex set, and let $0=μ_0(Ω)<μ_1(Ω)\le μ_2(Ω)\le\cdots$ be the Neumann eigenvalues of the Laplacian, repeated according to multiplicity. We prove the sharp bounds $$ μ_2(Ω)\le 4μ_1(Ω),\qquad μ_3(Ω)\le 9μ_1(Ω). $$ The first estimate resolves a problem attributed to Henrot, while the second gives the next sharp case predicted by the one-dimensional model. The constants are optimal in every dimension.
